topic: Launching Mexico and JCD Brazil inventory
summary_markdown: The discussion focused on the immediate need to launch inventory for two locations: Mexico and JCD Brazil (airport). For Mexico, specific tasks include setting up frequency and demographics in production, and opening campaigns to track impressions. Regarding JCD Brazil, it is critical to release at least some data today, such as categories matching Kido's existing setup, even if full implementation isn't possible immediately. The remaining inventory is generally considered manageable.
decisions: Mexico launch requires setting up frequency and demographics in production.
JCD Brazil must have at least partial data released today (e.g., categories matching Kido).
action_items: Complete Mexico setup (frequency, demographics) and open campaigns for impression tracking.
Ensure partial release of JCD Brazil data today.
